title: Azusawa Kohane — Getting Her The Best Chocolate〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The weather's so nice today and there's hardly any wind. It's the perfect day for a photo shoot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to get started!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aoyagi did an amazing job with his makeup. So now it's my turn to step up.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to do my best and win those chocolates by Couleur Chocolat for An!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, Azusawa, are we going to pass through Vivid Street on our way over?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought it'd be a nice shortcut...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, wait... I guess you wouldn't want anyone we know to see you wearing makeup, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that's not really a problem...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm more worried about everyone Shiraishi knows. It's hard to say which of them knows about this photo contest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, An is friends with that freelance photographer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which means we need to be careful about where we go...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's just go through Main Street.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The location for our shoot's just around that corner.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means we'll be starting soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and I'll need to do my best as a mod—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Aoyagi?
Our turn's further up ahead, not here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I know. But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I see Shiraishi up ahead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Haruka
rows.Line:
What?!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You're right!
She's coming from that direction!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're headed straight for each other.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah... Wait, my camera!
I can't let her see it! Let me just put it back in my bag and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll hide behind those vending machines until she passes us. Can you two handle the talking?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What do we say to her...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just keep things simple and follow my lead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I knew it!
That person I saw looked way too much like you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh... H-Hi, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, you're with Haruka?
Kinda rare to see you two together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I was just asking her for some advice regarding what chocolates I should give the others in my group.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, was Toya also with you...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! What makes you say that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
He was the first one I saw actually.
I could've sworn he was standing here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
He's your guys' teammate, right...?
I didn't notice since I was enjoying our conversation so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? Then, I guess it was just my imagination...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, An, what brings you here? Doing some shopping?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Heehee. Yeah, kinda...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Get ready to have your mind blown, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Bye, you two!
Have fun shopping!
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like she bought it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Thank goodness...
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that. I didn't think avoiding Vivid Street would lead to this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If anything, we should consider ourselves lucky.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Running into An here means there's less of a chance of us bumping into her somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you have a point.
Thank you for taking care of that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, Haruka, it was incredible how you were able to keep your cool. I was so nervous that I thought she'd see that something was up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think that just comes from how I've been taught to expect the unexpected when doing shoots and live programs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But that's still very impressive.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just a matter of experience.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's head over so we can start shooting. Lead the way, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! It's this way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Haruka's so reliable.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that we have her on our side for this!)
